checks.check: A concurrent forget, binding change, generation change or expiry prevents stale content from returning.
checks.evidence: reads.ts:145–148 validates freshness, but its finally block then awaits reader release at line 154. NativePinnedReader.close() awaits beforeClose (native-reads.ts:90), wired to the asynchronous read-close hook. While cleanup waits, a forget, binding change or expiry can occur; cleanup then completes and the previously validated projection returns without revalidation. The passing race tests pause at read-before-final and do not exercise this later window.

checks.check: Lease/dependency/result limits fail explicitly without truncation, and no native handles escape the private facade.
checks.evidence: ReadLeases enforces 16 leases with BACKPRESSURE and rejects result, dependency and byte overflow with CONTEXT_OVERFLOW. Native queries request limit+1 to detect overflow. Snapshots contain frozen scalar metadata registered by identity; native tables remain private. Test assertions cover capacity, overflow, forged/cross-instance leases and scalar-only projections. All four required named test groups have relevant assertions in store-reads.test.ts; the daemon reports all 11 cases passing.

verdict.reason: The t9 changes stay within the storage snapshot surface, but asynchronous cleanup after final validation leaves a stale-return window.
